# Subway Seat for delta

Each flavor is a delta feature. Code keeps its syntax colors on avocado and redbird line tints, changed words sit on a stronger tint, and line numbers take the tint of their line. Moved code (with `diff.colorMoved`) gets fainter tints, in step with the git port. Syntax colors come from the bat theme of the same name, so install the bat port and run `bat cache --build`.

[delta](https://github.com/dandavison/delta) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/delta/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.gitconfig`](subway-seat.gitconfig) | `~/.config/delta/subway-seat.gitconfig` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig`](subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig) | `~/.config/delta/subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig`](subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig) | `~/.config/delta/subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig` |
| All three | [`themes.gitconfig`](themes.gitconfig) | `~/.config/delta/subway-seat-flavors.gitconfig` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.gitconfig or ~/.config/git/config, with delta already set as your pager. If you have a `features` line, add the flavor to it instead:

```ini
[include]
	path = ~/.config/delta/subway-seat.gitconfig
[delta]
	features = subway-seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.gitconfig or ~/.config/git/config, with delta already set as your pager. If you have a `features` line, add the flavor to it instead:

```ini
[include]
	path = ~/.config/delta/subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig
[delta]
	features = subway-seat-tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.gitconfig or ~/.config/git/config, with delta already set as your pager. If you have a `features` line, add the flavor to it instead:

```ini
[include]
	path = ~/.config/delta/subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig
[delta]
	features = subway-seat-enamel
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/delta/subway-seat.gitconfig`.
- Delete `~/.config/delta/subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig`.
- Delete `~/.config/delta/subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig`.
- Delete `~/.config/delta/subway-seat-flavors.gitconfig`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
